DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 再発行のお問い合わせでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。カードが届きましたが、この銀行の再発行分かわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 届いたカードが再発行分か照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. A card arrived, but I don't know whether it's the replacement from this bank.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the card that arrived is the replacement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発行元の案内をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please look at the issuer information.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 別の会社名があります。前に申し込んだ買物用のカードかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別発行元と別申込みの可能性を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: There's a different company name. It may be the shopping card I applied for earlier.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify a different issuer and the possibility of another application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 当行の再発行状況とは分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check that separately from our bank's reissuance status.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。カードが一枚届いたから、紛失の手続きが終わったとは思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一枚到着を紛失対応完了としない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I'll avoid assuming the lost-card procedure is complete just because one card has arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not treat the arrival of one card as completion of the lost-card response. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 当行の受付控えはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have our bank's acknowledgment copy?

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。これです。届いた方の封筒とは別に持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 銀行受付控えと別封筒を分けて提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, here it is. I have it separately from the envelope for the card that arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present the bank acknowledgment separately from the other envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 控えで進捗を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check progress using the acknowledgment.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。届いたカードの登録を、銀行の再発行確認として進めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 別カード登録と銀行状況確認を混同しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll avoid treating registration of the card that arrived as confirmation of the bank's replacement.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not confuse registering another card with checking the bank's status. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 当行の状況はこの控えから確認します。別会社のカードについては、その発行元の案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-UOZU-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll check our bank's status from this acknowledgment. For the other company's card, please check that issuer's instructions.

DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 包装台へ戻る前に、手袋に破れがないか見てください。
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before returning to the packing bench, please check your gloves for tears.

DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 右手の指先に穴があります。最後の三袋には、この手袋で触れました。
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手袋の破れと触れた袋の数を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-02.translation: There's a hole at the fingertips of my right glove. I touched the last three bags with this glove.
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the torn glove and the number of bags touched. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その三袋を出荷用の箱に入れず、確認待ちとして区別しましょう。
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's keep those three bags separate as awaiting inspection, rather than putting them in the shipping box.

DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: どの袋か分かるよう、台の左端に並べておいてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三袋を区別して置く位置を提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-04.translation: May I line them up at the left edge of the bench so we know which bags they are?
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Suggest where to place the three bags separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認待ちのトレーを使ってください。私は責任者へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please use the awaiting-inspection tray. I'll contact the supervisor.

DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: トレーへ移しました。破れた手袋はどこで外せばいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 破れた手袋を外す場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've moved them to the tray. Where should I take off the torn glove?
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask where to remove the torn glove. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 製品から離れて交換場所へ行き、そこの手順に従って外してください。
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-07.translation: Go away from the products to the changing area and remove it following the procedure there.

DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 手洗いと交換が終わっても、確認待ちの三袋は戻さないのですね。
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 隔離製品を自己判断で戻さないことを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-08.translation: Even after washing my hands and changing gloves, I shouldn't put the three bags awaiting inspection back, correct?
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will not return isolated products on your own judgment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、製品の判断は責任者が行います。戻ったら私に声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct. The supervisor will make the product decision. Please tell me when you return.

DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三袋は残したまま、先に交換場所へ行ってきます。
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 製品を残して手袋交換へ向かうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll leave the three bags here and go to the changing area first.
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will leave the products and go to change gloves. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらでトレーを見ておきます。では、いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-WKY-KAINAN-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll watch the tray here. See you shortly.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ほうきの売り場をご覧ですね。屋内用をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at the broom section. Are you looking for an indoor one?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 外のベランダ用です。排水口の周りにたまる砂を掃きたいんです。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ベランダの砂掃除に使うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's for the outdoor balcony. I'd like to sweep the sand that collects around the drain.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that it will be used to clean sand on a balcony. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 細いほうきなら角に届きますが、ちり取りは別売りです。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: A narrow broom can reach corners, but the dustpan is sold separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この長い柄は、収納棚の高さ八十センチに収まりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 収納棚の高さに柄が収まるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Will this long handle fit in a storage cupboard eighty centimeters high?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether the handle fits the storage cupboard's height. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 柄を短くできるタイプがあります。縮めた状態の長さを見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: There's a type with a shortening handle. Let's look at its length when retracted.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 縮める部分が緩まないか、展示品で動かしてみてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 伸縮部の固定を展示品で試す許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: May I try moving the display item to see whether the telescoping section comes loose?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask permission to test the telescoping section's fastening on the display item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どうぞ、ここを回して固定します。ちり取りも一緒に掛けられますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Go ahead. Turn here to lock it. You can hang the dustpan with it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 棚の扉に掛けたいので、厚みも測っていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 扉に掛けるため重ねた厚みの測定を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to hang them on the cupboard door, so could you measure the thickness too?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the combined thickness to be measured for hanging on a door. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二つを重ねると、この幅になります。棚の奥行きと比べてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Stacking the two gives this width. Please compare it with the cupboard's depth.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 奥行きは足りています。この伸縮式と薄いちり取りを買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 収納条件に合うほうきとちり取りを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: There's enough depth. I'll buy this telescoping broom and the thin dustpan.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose a broom and dustpan that meet the storage conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二点をレジへお持ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take the two items to the register. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この列の箱は、作業票の番号を見て仕分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Sort the boxes in this row by the numbers on the work slips.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二番目の箱だけ紙がぬれて、番号の下半分が読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 箱の作業票がぬれて番号を読めないと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only the second box's paper is wet, and I can't read the bottom half of the number.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that a box's work slip is wet and its number unreadable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 読めない箱はまだ運ばないでください。元の伝票と照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please don't move the unreadable box yet. We'll compare it with the original slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 隣の箱と魚は同じに見えますが、同じ行き先とは限らないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 魚の種類だけで行き先を決められないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The fish look the same as in the neighboring box, but that doesn't necessarily mean the destination is the same, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that fish type alone cannot determine the destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そうです、魚の種類だけでは決められません。その箱は今どこにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Correct, fish type alone isn't enough. Where is that box now?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 台車には載せず、元の列の二番目に置いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不明な箱を元の列に残していると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't loaded it on the cart. It's still second in the original row.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the uncertain box remains in its original row. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのまま位置を変えずに待ってください。私は伝票を取りに行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please wait without changing its position. I'll get the slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 後から来る運搬の人にも、まだ動かさないよう伝えましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 運搬担当者へ保留を伝えることを提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Should I also tell the transport worker coming later not to move it yet?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Offer to tell the transport worker about the hold. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お願いします。番号が確認できるまで待っている、と伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. Tell them we're waiting until the number is confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 運搬の方へ声をかけてから、表示の読める箱の作業に戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 保留を伝えて他の箱の仕分けを進めると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll speak to the transport worker, then return to the boxes with readable labels.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will pass on the hold and continue sorting other boxes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順でお願いします。では、私は事務所へ行ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please follow that order. I'm going to the office.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 小型冷蔵庫をお探しでしたら、こちらに展示があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: If you're looking for a compact refrigerator, we have displays here.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 部屋の棚の横に置きたいです。空いている幅は五十センチです。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷蔵庫を置く空間の幅を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to put it beside the shelving in my room. The available width is fifty centimeters.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give the width of the space for the refrigerator. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本体の幅だけでなく、放熱に必要な隙間も説明書で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the manual for the heat-release clearance as well as the unit's width.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この機種を置くと、棚側の隙間が足りなくなりそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 必要な放熱隙間が足りないと指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: If I put this model there, it looks like there won't be enough clearance on the shelf side.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out that the necessary heat-release clearance is insufficient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この寸法だとそうですね。置き場所を変えられそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: With these dimensions, that's right. Could you change its position?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 窓側なら広いですが、扉を開けると机に当たるかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別の置き場所では扉が机に当たる懸念を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: There's more space by the window, but the door might hit my desk when opened.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain concern that the door will hit the desk at the alternative position. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 扉を開いたときの寸法も測っておきましょう。床に印を付けて確かめると分かりやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's measure its dimensions with the door open too. Marking the floor to check makes it easier to understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 機種名と開いたときの寸法を、メモして帰ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 機種名と開扉寸法を持ち帰りたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: May I note down the model name and open-door dimensions and take them home?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to take the model name and open-door dimensions home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、寸法表をお渡しします。電源コードが届く位置かも確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, I'll give you a dimension chart. Please also check whether the power cord will reach.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は買わずに、窓側のスペースとコンセントを測り直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入を保留して設置場所と電源位置を測ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't buy it today. I'll remeasure the window-side space and the outlet position.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hold off buying and say you will measure the placement and power position. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 寸法が分かったら、またご相談ください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please ask again once you know the dimensions. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切符をご確認中ですか。改札の手前でお伺いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you checking your ticket? I'll speak to you before the gates.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 券面の着駅が、友人から教わった駅名と違っているんです。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 切符と予定の着駅が違うと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The arrival station printed on my ticket differs from the station my friend told me.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a mismatch between your ticket and intended arrival station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の切符と、予定の駅名を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you show me your current ticket and the planned station name?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この切符は手前の駅までです。友人が待つのは、もう一駅先でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 切符の区間が一駅手前までだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: This ticket only goes to the station before it. My friend is waiting one station farther on.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your ticket's route ends one station short. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 区間の変更について窓口で確認しましょう。まだ改札には入っていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check a route change at the desk. You haven't entered the gates yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、入る前に気付きました。券売機で新しく買い直す必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入場前であると伝えて買い直しの必要性を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Correct, I noticed before entering. Do I need to buy a new ticket at the machine?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not entered and ask whether you need to buy again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二重に買う前に、今の切符を窓口へお持ちください。扱いと差額を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Before buying twice, please take your current ticket to the desk. We'll check the handling and fare difference.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 窓口で説明するため、友人の駅名を紙に書いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 正しい駅名を書いてもらうよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Could you write my friend's station name on paper so I can explain at the desk?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the correct station name in writing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらに書きます。窓口はこの通路の右側です。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll write it here. The desk is on the right of this passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 切符とこの紙を持って、変更できるか窓口で聞いてきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在の切符を持って変更について窓口で尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take my ticket and this paper and ask at the desk whether I can change it.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will take the current ticket to the desk and ask about a change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのあと行き先表示も確かめてください。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the destination display afterward too. Have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 忘れ物のお問い合わせですね。何をお忘れになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about a lost item. What did you leave behind?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 青い書類袋です。電車を降りてから、手に持っていないと気付きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 電車を降りたあと青い書類袋の紛失に気付いたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: A blue document pouch. After getting off the train, I realized I no longer had it in my hand.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you noticed the loss of a blue document pouch after getting off the train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご利用の列車と、置いた場所に心当たりはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know which train you used and where you left it?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 九時ごろ着いた列車で、進行方向の最後の車両の網棚に載せました。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 列車の到着時間と最後尾車両の網棚を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was the train arriving around nine. I put it on the luggage rack in the last carriage in the direction of travel.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the train's arrival time and luggage rack in the rearmost carriage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記録を確認します。袋の中に、持ち主が分かるものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the records. Is there anything inside that identifies the owner?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社名が入った封筒がありますが、私の名前は書いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社名入り封筒はあるが本人名はないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: There's an envelope with my company's name, but my own name isn't written on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say there is an envelope bearing the company name but not your own name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 色と封筒の特徴も記録します。今のところ、該当する届出は見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll record the color and envelope features too. For now, I can't find a matching report.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日使う書類なので、見つかったときの連絡先を残せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発見時の連絡先を残せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I need the documents today. May I leave contact details for when it's found?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may leave contact details for a discovery. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、こちらへ電話番号をご記入ください。受取り方法は発見後にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please write your phone number here. We'll explain collection after it's found.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号を書きました。職場にも書類の到着が遅れると連絡しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先を記入し職場へ書類の遅延を伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've written the number. I'll tell my workplace that the documents will arrive late too.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have written contact details and will tell work about the document delay. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お問い合わせ内容をお預かりします。では、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll keep the details of your inquiry. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は二人一組で材料を切ります。始める前に、困っていることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Today you'll cut ingredients in pairs. Is there anything troubling you before starting?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日、人差し指を切ってしまいました。今日は包丁を持つのが不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 指の負傷で包丁を使うのが不安だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I cut my index finger yesterday. I'm uneasy about holding a kitchen knife today.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your finger injury makes you anxious about using a knife. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 無理に切る作業はしないでください。傷のある手で食材に触れるのも避けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please don't force yourself to do cutting work. Let's also avoid touching ingredients with the injured hand.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 食材を触らずに参加できる役割はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 食材に触れず参加できる役割を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Is there a role where I can participate without touching the ingredients?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for a role that allows participation without touching food. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 調理手順を読み上げる役ならできます。相手の方には、切る作業をお願いしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can read the cooking steps aloud. Let's ask your partner to do the cutting.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 読み上げるとき、量だけでなく切る順番も伝えればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 読み上げる情報に量と作業順を含めると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: When reading, should I give the cutting order as well as the quantities?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that the information read aloud includes quantities and work order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、まず手順を一緒に読みます。安全な切り方は私が実演します。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, first we'll read the steps together. I'll demonstrate safe cutting.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 手元が見える位置で実演を見てから、読み上げを始めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 実演を見てから読み上げを始めたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to watch the demonstration from where I can see your hands before starting to read aloud.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to begin reading aloud after watching the demonstration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この位置なら見えますよ。熱い鍋も、今日は相手の方に任せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can see from this position. Please leave the hot pots to your partner today too.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は手順を読む役にします。片付けも、手をぬらさない作業を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 読み上げ役を選び片付けも負傷に配慮して相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I'll take the role of reading the steps. For cleanup too, I'll ask about work that won't get my hand wet.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the reading role and say you will discuss cleanup with consideration for the injury. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 片付けの分担は後で相談しましょう。私は準備に戻りますので、では、後ほど。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's discuss cleanup assignments later. I'll return to the preparations now. See you shortly.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居に関するお申込みですね。お引っ越しされるのは何人ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're applying in relation to a move. How many people are moving?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私一人です。同じ部屋に住んでいる友人は、今の住所に残ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分だけが転居し同居人は残ると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Just me. The friend sharing my room will remain at the current address.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that only you are moving and your roommate is staying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: では、対象となる方のお名前を区別して記入しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Then let's clearly identify the person concerned when entering the name.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 旧住所の欄に、建物名と部屋番号も全部書けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧住所の建物名と部屋番号の記載を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Should I write the full building name and room number in the old-address field too?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check whether the old building name and room number should be included. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、住所を省略せずに記入してください。新住所も確認できるものはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, please write the address without abbreviating it. Do you have something confirming the new address too?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 契約書の住所をメモしましたが、部屋番号を忘れてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新住所の部屋番号を忘れたと正直に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I noted the address from my contract, but I forgot the room number.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Honestly explain that you forgot the new address's room number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 不確かな番号を入れず、確認してから記入しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check before entering it, rather than putting in an uncertain number.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 途中まで書いた用紙を持ち帰り、確認後に出してもいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未完成の用紙を持ち帰って確認後に提出したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: May I take the partly filled form home and submit it after checking?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to take the unfinished form home and submit after confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、こちらの案内もお持ちください。提出時に必要な確認事項が載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please take this guide too. It lists the points to check when submitting.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 部屋番号を確かめて、自分の名前だけを対象者の欄に書いて戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部屋番号と対象者を確かめて再来する予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll confirm the room number, put only my name in the person-concerned field and return.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will return after checking the room number and the person concerned. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お戻りの際に、記入内容を一緒に確認しましょう。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KAINAN-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: When you return, let's check what you wrote together. Thank you.

DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 御朱印のお受け取りですね。お預かりしたときの札をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're collecting your temple seal book. Do you have the tag from when we received it?

DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 札をバッグに入れたはずですが、見当たりません。青い布の表紙の帳面です。
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受取札を紛失したことと御朱印帳の表紙を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I put the tag in my bag, but I can't find it. My book has a blue cloth cover.
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you lost the collection tag and describe the seal book's cover. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 青い表紙が二冊ありますので、色だけではお渡しできません。ほかに目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are two blue-covered books, so we can't hand it over based on color alone. Are there other identifying marks?

DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 裏表紙の内側に、鉛筆で自分の姓を書いてあります。
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の御朱印帳に書いた識別情報を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-04.translation: I wrote my surname in pencil on the inside of the back cover.
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the identifying information written in your own seal book. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 係の者がその部分を確認しますね。姓を小さな声で教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-05.translation: A staff member will check that area. Could you tell us your surname quietly?

DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: グエンです。名前を確かめるために、ほかの方のページを開かないでいただけますか。
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 姓を伝えほかの参拝者のページへの配慮を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Nguyen. Could you avoid opening other visitors' pages just to check the name?
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give your surname and ask for consideration of other visitors' pages. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、確認に必要な部分だけ拝見します。こちらがグエン様の帳面です。
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, we'll look only at the part needed for identification. This is your book, Nguyen.

DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 内側の名前が合っています。いただいた御朱印の墨が乾くまで、開いて持つほうがよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人の帳面と確認して墨の乾き方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-08.translation: The name inside matches. Should I hold it open until the ink of the seal I received dries?
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm it is your book and ask about letting the ink dry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まだ湿っていますから、紙に触れず少しお待ちください。お帰りの際は忘れ物にもお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-09.translation: It's still damp, so please wait a little without touching the paper. Please also watch for forgotten items when leaving.

DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 乾くまでこちらの端で待ってから、袋に入れて帰ります。お手数をおかけしました。
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 墨が乾くまで待ってから持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait at this side until it dries, then put it in my bag and go home. Thank you for your trouble.
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will wait until the ink dries before taking it home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お確かめいただけてよかったです。どうぞお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-WKY-KOYA-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'm glad we could confirm it. Please take care on your way home.
